name: The Ritz-Carlton, Lake Tahoe
insider_take: Perched mid-mountain at Northstar California, this alpine sanctuary offers the only ski-in, ski-out luxury experience at Lake Tahoe with year-round gondola access.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton Lake Tahoe sits at 6,000 feet elevation, making it one of the highest luxury resorts in North America. The property features a unique gondola system that connects directly to Northstar's slopes in winter and scenic mountain trails in summer. The resort's Spa at Northstar offers treatments in treetop cabins suspended 20 feet above the forest floor.
pro_tip: Book a lakefront residence for direct access to the private beach club and complimentary boat shuttle to explore Lake Tahoe's crystal-clear waters, which maintain visibility up to 70 feet deep.
dont_miss: The resort's fire pit experiences with s'mores under star-filled skies, and the exclusive Ritz-Carlton Lake Club with its private sandy beach on one of America's largest alpine lakes. In winter, enjoy night skiing on illuminated slopes accessible via the resort's gondola.
pros: Stunning Lake Tahoe location with panoramic mountain and lake views
Year-round outdoor activities including skiing, hiking, and water sports
Luxury spa and wellness facilities with alpine-inspired treatments
Exceptional dining options featuring locally-sourced cuisine
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and exclusive location
Remote mountain location requires advance planning for access
